Title: Scheduled Decision Prompt
I want: to be prompted at my chosen gym time
So that: I consistently confront the daily decision instead of avoiding it
Acceptance criteria: Given a selected daily time; When that time occurs; Then a prompt is delivered at that time; And delivery consistency is measurable

Title: Reduce Avoidance Delay
I want: to engage with the decision promptly when prompted
Acceptance criteria: Given a prompt occurs; When Jason interacts; Then interaction occurs within a measurable time window; And delay trends can be tracked

Title: Reinforce Commitment Frequency
I want: to be reminded of my intended weekly gym frequency
So that: I stay aligned with my 3–4 day goal
Acceptance criteria: Given a defined weekly goal; When prompted; Then the weekly target is referenced; And it reflects the defined goal

Title: Clarify Today’s Choice
I want: the decision framed as a simple yes-or-no commitment
So that: the mental debate feels less overwhelming
Acceptance criteria: Given scheduled gym time; When prompted; Then the choice is clearly attend or skip; And no unrelated decisions are introduced

Title: Normalize Low-Energy Days
I want: reassurance that low energy is normal
So that: low energy does not automatically justify skipping
Acceptance criteria: Given low energy is reported; When engaging with the prompt; Then low energy is acknowledged; And decision autonomy remains

Title: Weigh Long-Term Goals
I want: to reflect on my long-term fitness goal at the decision moment
Acceptance criteria: Given the decision moment; When prompted; Then long-term goal is referenced; And it matches stored goal

Title: Reduce Guilt-Based Pressure
I want: the decision framed without guilt or shame
So that: I feel ownership rather than pressure
Acceptance criteria: Given the prompt; When deciding; Then no guilt-based framing is present; And tone supports autonomy

Title: Reinforce Self-Trust
I want: to feel capable of choosing consistently
So that: I build confidence in my discipline
Acceptance criteria: Given prior attendance history; When prompted; Then consistency is acknowledged; And self-trust is reinforced

Title: Reduce Overthinking
I want: the decision moment to be brief
So that: I do not spiral into analysis
Acceptance criteria: Given decision interaction; When responding; Then minimal steps are required; And decision time is measurable

Title: Affirm Attendance Immediately
I want: immediate affirmation when I choose to go
Acceptance criteria: Given attendance is chosen; When confirmed; Then immediate positive reinforcement occurs; And it reflects the action

Title: Reinforce Effort as Progress
I want: choosing to go to feel like progress itself
Acceptance criteria: Given attendance is chosen; When confirmed; Then the choice is acknowledged as progress; And forward movement is reinforced

Title: Minimize Emotional Drop if Skipping
So that: one miss does not derail me
Acceptance criteria: Given skip is chosen; When confirmed; Then no shaming language appears; And next opportunity remains intact

Title: Preserve Next Opportunity
I want: the next scheduled gym opportunity to remain clear
So that: skipping once does not feel final
Acceptance criteria: Given a skipped day; When interaction concludes; Then next scheduled time remains unchanged; And no penalty is introduced

Title: Track Weekly Consistency
I want: awareness of how many times I’ve attended this week
So that: I know if I am on track
Acceptance criteria: Given attendance data exists; When reviewing week; Then weekly total is visible; And it reflects actual attendance

Title: Highlight Streak Recovery
I want: to see that I returned after a missed day
So that: I feel resilient rather than inconsistent
Acceptance criteria: Given a skipped day followed by attendance; When reviewing; Then recovery is acknowledged; And prior progress is preserved

Title: Measure Decision Hesitation
I want: my hesitation time to decrease over weeks
Acceptance criteria: Given decision time is tracked; When comparing weeks; Then average hesitation can be compared; And reductions identified

Title: Build Self-Sufficiency Confidence
I want: to feel increasingly confident I can maintain this habit independently
So that: I rely less on external pressure
Acceptance criteria: Given sustained consistency; When reflecting; Then confidence can be reported; And trends improve over time

Title: Validate Habit Stability Over Time
I want: to see that my weekly attendance is becoming stable
So that: I know this is a real habit
Acceptance criteria: Given multi-week data; When reviewing attendance; Then weeks meeting goal are visible; And trends are observable
